caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a man standing atop a rectangular, gray-colored pedestal. The man is dressed in a red long-sleeve buttoned jacket with yellow cuffs, tan-colored pants, and black knee-high boots. He is wearing a yellow cap with a red brim, and his face and hands are painted black. His left arm is bent at the elbow and extends outward, holding a metal ring upright with his hand, while his right hand rests on his hip. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color. To the right of the statue, the name "David E. Walley" is inscribed.
title: Hitching Post
